ablation.baseline: b3_eq_zero (identical settings: w_eq=0, readout_norm=none), HRD seed 1, 5 folds
ablation.rationale: The trend positive was two augmented copies of the same week: raw input alone retrieves it at top-1 0.891 among 3,803 weeks, so training learns to copy and the task saturates (DSSL and the CoST reference both). Disjoint days of the same week share no timestep (simple features: top-1 0.002-0.016), and a week is kept out of its own negatives. Untrained, real negatives: top-1 0.688 -> 0.062.
